label: County count
summary: The number of counties that follow the faith.
details: A whole number. The faith window prints it before the word 'counties' and dims a part of the window when it is 0.

label: Follower count
summary: The number of followers (adherents) of the faith.
details: A whole number. The faith window prints it before 'Adherents'; the ledger shows it and hides that part when it is 0.

label: Holy site count
summary: The number of holy sites the faith has.
details: A whole number. The ledger shows it as the second half of 'controlled / total', next to the count of holy sites its followers control.

label: Holy war count
summary: The number of holy wars connected to the faith.
details: A whole number. The ledger shows it with the war icon and hides that part when it is 0. Going by its name, it counts the faith's holy wars; the game documents nothing more.

label: Ruler count
summary: The number of rulers of the faith.
details: A whole number, shown in the ledger. Going by its name, it counts the rulers who follow the faith.

label: Sinner count
summary: The number of sinners in the faith.
details: A whole number, shown in the ledger. The game does not say here what makes someone a sinner; going by its name it is about the faith's sins.

label: Virtuous count
summary: The number of virtuous followers of the faith.
details: A whole number, shown in the ledger. The game does not say here what makes someone virtuous; going by its name it is about the faith's virtues.

label: Origin faith
summary: The faith this faith came from, going by its name.
details: Nothing in the game's texts or GUI uses it, and its return type is not registered. The game documents nothing more.

label: Relation name to
summary: The word for how this faith regards another faith.
details: Vanilla uses it for the faith view's 'They consider us ...' and 'We consider this faith ...' lines: the faith it is called on is the one judging, the faith given in the brackets is the one being judged. Returns text.

label: Religion
summary: The religion the faith belongs to.
details: Vanilla chains more functions after it, such as GetAdjective, to write the religion's name in texts.

label: Head of faith
summary: The character who is head of the faith.
details: Vanilla chains name functions after it (full name, short name) in the head-of-faith tooltips.

label: Head of faith title
summary: The title of the faith's religious head, going by its name.
details: The faith window and the ledger use it as the data of a block that shows a title. The game gives no return type.

label: Rites
summary: The list of the faith's rites.
details: The faith window counts its entries and shows one fewer as 'Branched rites', which suggests one entry is the main rite. A list, not a single value.

label: Faith tag
summary: A short text id of the faith, going by its name.
details: Nothing in the game uses it on a faith; the lines with the same name belong to provinces. The game documents nothing more.

label: Tenet background icon
summary: The background picture for a tenet icon of this faith.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture, giving a rite and a tenet type. The game documents nothing more.

label: Small tenet background
summary: The background picture for a small tenet icon of this faith.
details: Same use as the large version: a texture chosen from a rite and a tenet type, used in the faith window and the personal beliefs window.

label: Tenet popularity score
summary: The popularity score of a tenet within this faith.
details: A whole number. Vanilla prints it in brackets after the popularity tier name in the tenet tooltips and the decision tenet picker.

label: Faith icon in text
summary: The faith's icon, to show inside a text.
details: Vanilla puts it right before the faith's name in conversion effect texts ("... converts to [icon][name]").

label: Theocracy lease contract
summary: The contract type for theocratic leases of the faith, going by its name.
details: Nothing in the game uses it and its return type is not registered. The game documents nothing more.

label: Military strength
summary: The total military strength of the faith.
details: A whole number, shown in the ledger. The game documents nothing more; going by its name it is a military strength figure for the faith.

label: Faith type
summary: The type of the faith, going by its name.
details: Nothing in the game uses it on a faith; the lines with the same name belong to other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Yearly fervor change
summary: How much the faith's fervor changes per year.
details: A decimal number that can be negative. The faith window shows one part when it is above 0 and another when it is below 0, and picks icon frame 5 instead of 4 when it is above 1.

label: Fervor change text
summary: A text that explains the faith's yearly fervor change.
details: Going by its name and its single use in the fervor tooltip, it is a description of where the yearly change comes from. Returns text.

label: Good god names
summary: The names of the faith's good gods, going by its name.
details: Only lines with the same name on other types exist: one prints the faith's good gods in an accolade, one has a character say they will teach others about them. No use is shown on a faith itself.

label: Has doctrine
summary: Whether the faith has the given doctrine.
details: Returns yes or no. The windows use it to show a doctrine only when the faith has it.

label: Has doctrine (by key)
summary: Whether the faith has the doctrine with the given key.
details: Returns yes or no. The faith window uses it with the keys of the head-of-faith doctrines (no head, spiritual head, temporal head) to show matching parts.

label: Has great holy war
summary: Whether the faith has an offensive great holy war, going by its name.
details: The HUD calls it on the player's faith to decide whether to show something. Vanilla only shows that one use.

label: Has faith parameter
summary: Whether the faith has the parameter with the given key.
details: Returns yes or no. Vanilla checks 'has_clerical_electors' with it to show the election parts of the HUD and the faith window.

label: Has reserved names
summary: Whether the faith has reserved names for the given gender, going by its name.
details: The ruler designer calls it with its 'is female' value. The game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Whether the female names are meant.

label: Has tenet status
summary: Whether the given tenet has the given status in the faith.
details: Returns yes or no. Vanilla checks the statuses 'prohibited' and 'unknown' to hide or disable tenet entries in the faith window.

details: No game text uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Health god, her/his

details: Vanilla writes it right after the god's name in an event text ('... is fading slowly, ... smile ...').

label: Health god name
summary: The name of the faith's god of health.
details: Returns text. Used in many event and legend texts, for example in a legend about a hero relying on the god's mercy.

label: Health god name's
summary: The name of the faith's god of health in possessive form, as in 'Name's'.
details: Vanilla uses it in nicknames ('... Mercy'), in a building name ('Great Shrine of ...') and in event speech. These uses come from other types' lines with the same name.

label: High god name's
summary: The name of the faith's high god in possessive form, as in 'Name's'.
details: Returns text. Used in legend texts and in many events and decisions.

label: High god, she/he

details: Vanilla uses it in event texts, but only through lines with the same name on other types.

label: Household god name's

label: Is dead faith

details: No game text or GUI uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is divergent rite value

details: Returns yes or no. The value breakdown window passes its number to it to show one of two variants.

label: Is eminent holy site
summary: Whether the given holy site is an eminent holy site for this faith.
details: Returns yes or no. Vanilla uses it to pick between the texts for an 'eminent' and a 'regular' holy site.

label: Is historical only
summary: Whether the faith exists only as a historical faith.
details: Returns yes or no. The ruler designer hides a part when it is true. Going by its name, such a faith is not meant for new rulers.

label: Is holy site
summary: Whether the given thing is a holy site of the faith, going by its name.
details: No game text or GUI uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether this faith is the one selected in the window, going by its name.
details: Returns yes or no. The faith window uses it to show a part only for the selected faith.

label: Is trait a sin
summary: Whether the given trait is a sin for the faith, going by its name.
details: No use on a faith is shown. The only lines with the same name call it on a rite and test a trait.

label: Is trait a virtue
summary: Whether the given trait is a virtue for the faith, going by its name.
details: No use on a faith is shown. The only lines with the same name call it on a rite and test a trait.

label: Is unreformed
summary: Whether the faith is unreformed.
details: Returns yes or no. The faith window and the ruler designer show different parts for unreformed and reformed faiths.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether the faith exists, so it is safe to show or use.
details: Returns yes or no. The HUD and its notifications use it to show a faith part only when there is a faith.

label: Is visible in GUI
summary: Whether the faith is shown in the game's interface.
details: Returns yes or no. The faith window shows parts only for such faiths and the ledger enables its faith entries by it.

label: Faith as scope

details: Vanilla gives it to a scripted GUI check together with the name 'faith', so the script can read the faith as scope:faith. It is a conversion, not a value to show.
